text:
Maya: quick share — ran a small holdout with a new prefetch heuristic i’m calling 'sunburst-prefetch' on quant-13b-v2 q4_0. 5k conv-bench samples. results below, tl;dr: latency upside looks good, quality drift on long context.
Sam: can you paste the exact run command + seed? :eyes:  we should be able to reproduce quickly.
Maya: yep — command used: 
```
./bench_run --model quant-13b-v2-q4_0 --prefetch sunburst --holdout-set conv-5k.json --seed 42 --batch 8 --spec-fallback true --early-abort 0.6
```
Maya: median latency ~110ms -> 76ms (prefetch on), p95 280ms -> 246ms. throughput ~= +1.45x.
Joel: interesting. what's the eval battery? ppl/rouge/qa? the ppl bump worries me for generation coherence.
Maya: holdout was ppl + rougeL on longform slice (4k context), and a small chat-fluency manual spotcheck. ppl went 12.10 -> 12.45 (+2.8%), rougeL on longforms 0.62 -> 0.58 (-4 pts). chat spotcheck flagged more trailing hallucinations in ~3% of samples.
Adrian: can you re-run with different seeds and with `early-abort=0.4` and `kv-warmup=true` to see if prefetch aggressiveness is the cause? I can spin a dedicated job.
Maya: will queue that. re-run plan: seeds [7, 99], ablations: (1) no speculative fallback, (2) early-abort=0.4, (3) kv-warmup on. also add tokenization parity check.
eval-bot: auto-summary posted: 
- samples: 5000
- median latency: 110ms -> 76ms (prefetch)
- p95 latency: 280ms -> 246ms
- ppl: 12.10 -> 12.45 (+2.8%)
- rougeL (longform): 0.62 -> 0.58 (-4 pts)
- flagged regressions: trailing-hallucination ~3% (manual audit)
Petra: tradeoff looks nontrivial. we should run a blind A/B on 1k real chat sessions before any canary. also add a user-facing metric (satisfaction proxy) if possible.
Sam: also double-check tokenization and detokenized length distribution post-quant; sometimes quant build pipelines change whitespace handling.
Joel: please mark as "quality-regression-potential" in the ticket and set rollback trigger: rougeL drop >3 pts OR ppl +3% on longforms = auto-disable sunburst on that model.
Adrian: i'll add a dashboard circuit-breaker and an alert. i'll also queue the ablation runs on dedicated pool now.
Maya: thanks. i'll push an ops note in the repo with reproduction steps, logs, and the ablation matrix. will post results when reruns finish.
Maya: quick question — anyone object to shipping this as a short ops doc and gating canary until AB results are in? :thinking_face:
Joel: no objections, just add the rollback criteria and callout on long-context tests.
Petra: agreed, and add the plan for the 1k blind A/B.
Sam: ping me when ablations complete, i'll run a small qual pass.
Maya: will do. queued jobs ~ETA 45m.
